summary: Jupiter Neurosciences filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of equity under its existing Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) with YA II PN, Ltd. (Yorkville). Between May 14 and July 24, 2026, the company issued 11,470,000 shares for approximately $3.6 million gross proceeds, priced at 97% of the lowest VWAP during each three-day pricing period. The filing also discloses the resulting share count of 56,520,143. This is a routine equity-line drawdown under a previously disclosed financing arrangement, not a standalone special situation requiring classification.
